svg.title: The heater's step response and two transfer-function predictions
svg.desc: After the setpoint steps from 35 to 36 degrees Celsius, the water stays at 35.00 degrees for the 1 second delay, then rises and settles at 35.50 degrees with a 77.50 percent heater command. The delay-free transfer function rises at once; the loop computed with the delay follows the heater within 0.021 degrees.
svg.text: The heater's step response and two predictions from its transfer function
Control Studio recording of this project · P control, Kp = 5 %/°C · numbers answer the predictions
